description:
Lisaan helps you write, rewrite, review and adapt Arabic inside your AI conversation. It returns task-specific writing guidance and review findings; your AI host composes the final text.

Keep your supplied facts, adjust tone for your audience, and inspect suggested corrections before using the result. Check names, dates, meaning and commitments.

Your Lisaan account keeps the same writing preferences across compatible hosts. You can view, withdraw or delete preferences and request account data deletion from your Lisaan account page.

Access requires an active Lisaan entitlement or approved testing access. Lisaan stores review text and limited operational records as explained in its privacy policy, including retention and user controls. Your AI host has its own data policy.
